title: Stop Doing This At Intersections (Part 2)
hook: Part two! Keep your wheels straight.

script.narration: Part two! Keep your wheels straight.
script.visual_search: car waiting to turn left at intersection interior view

script.narration: When waiting to turn left on a flashing yellow arrow, never pre-turn your steering wheel. If you get rear-ended, pointed wheels push you straight into oncoming traffic.
script.visual_search: dashboard view of intersection traffic light changing

script.narration: Like if this saved you, follow for daily driving tips. Did you know this? Comment yes or no.
script.visual_search: driver hands holding steering wheel straight

script.narration: Protect yourself at every light because part two! Keep your wheels straight.
script.visual_search: car front wheels aligned straight on asphalt

description:
Part 2 of our intersection safety series! Learn the correct way to position your car when waiting to turn left on a flashing yellow arrow to avoid rear-end collisions into oncoming traffic.

Essential driving tips for new drivers navigating busy city streets.
why_it_will_work: Directly continues a proven top-performing series topic on intersection safety while delivering high-intent practical safety advice.
